entries.title: Learn the Fried Grasshopper Legs recipe from Charles Orleans

npc.name: Charles Orleans#cook
npc.service_role: Cooking lesson and recipe ingredients exchange

conditions: The character must already be assigned cooking lesson stage 1; a new lesson at cooking_q = 0 randomly assigns one of six recipes, so players cannot choose which of these recipes they receive.
The NPC only proceeds for non-Novice characters wearing item 5026 (Chef Hat) in the equipment slot checked by the script.
The script stops if fewer than 2000 weight units are free.

All listed ingredients must be present. On completion the inputs are removed, cooking_q advances to 7, and one dish is granted; this lesson recipe is taught once per character progression and has no random failure roll. If the character later loses the Bundle of Food during the follow-up stage and returns reporting it lost while still carrying the cookbook, Madeleine removes the cookbook and resets cooking_q to 0, allowing the lesson chain to restart.

entries.title: The squirrel trades an Acorn offering for a random gem or jewel

outcomes.label: Common gem (Peridot/Agate/Citrin/Rose Quartz/Turquoise/Pyroxene/Phlogopite/Biotite/Muscovite)
outcomes.condition: ~89.9% combined outer band (cyworld in six disjoint 100-point-wide bands of 1000); the specific gem depends on a second 1-10 sub-roll within each band

outcomes.label: Precious/colored jewel via S_BS_1 (Dark Red/Violet/Skyblue/Azure/Scarlet/Cardinal/Red/Golden/Bluish Green Jewel)
outcomes.condition: within any of the six 100-point bands, an inner stworld roll 0-89 (of 150) routes to the S_BS_1 sub-table instead of the common gem

outcomes.label: Cursed Ruby / Cardinal Jewel
outcomes.condition: cyworld outside 1-1000's named bands (500-900 and above 900 fallback ranges)

conditions: Requires 20 Acorn, consumed unconditionally on each offering.

The reward is a nested weighted roll: an outer 1-1000 roll (cyworld) selects a band, most of which run an inner 1-150 roll (stworld) that either falls through to a common named gem, or (stworld<90) calls a shared S_BS_1 sub-function for a rarer colored jewel from its own 1-90 sub-table. This is documented at the level of visible branch structure; exact combined odds per specific item were not independently recomputed beyond the coded thresholds.

This is a source bug, not a documented feature: a player with fewer than 5 Ora Ora still receives the Oxygen Mask for free. Recorded as observed rather than as intended design.

entries.title: Merchant Marx Hansen blends fresh fruit into juices
conditions: Requires completing the Juice Maker introduction quest (MISC_QUEST & 1, by showing meat to Little Morrison and speaking to Marianne in Prontera).
Each juice requires 1 of the designated fruit, 1 Empty Bottle, and 3 zeny fee.
Can craft as many as inventory/zeny allow or a custom quantity up to 100 per transaction.

entries.title: RuRumuni crafts a Leather Bag of Infinity
conditions: Requires 1 Cactus Needle, 1 Cobweb, and 1 Earthworm Peeling; all three are consumed and a Leather Bag of Infinity is granted.
The branch also sets skill_thief_1 to 2, a flag consumed by a separate, unreviewed skill-learning step at the Thief guild's Alcouskou.

entries.title: Talpiz accepts a custom weapon delivery for the Blacksmith job change (Merchant Voucher)
conditions: Requires the specific custom-made Arbalest Bow delivered for this NPC's job-change branch (BSMITH_Q reaches 14); the weapon is consumed and one Merchant Voucher is granted.
This is one of five parallel city delivery branches for the same Blacksmith 2-1 job-change step; the Geffen branch (Baisulist) is already reviewed as geffen_baisulist_weapon_delivery_voucher.

entries.title: Pet Enthusiast converts liquor scraps into Spirit Liquor
conditions: Requires at least 20 Broken Liquor Jar and 1 Alcohol in inventory before the script consumes both and grants 20 Spirit Liquor for Wanderer-class pets.

entries.title: Rebarev Doug crafts Gleipnir
conditions: Requires 4 Cat Tread, 5 Woman's Moustache, 4 Root of Stone, 3 Sputum of Bird, and 3 Sinew of Bear; all five are consumed and Gleipnir is granted.

entries.title: Sir Gray crafts a Claymore
conditions: Requires 1 Steel and 74,000 zeny; both are consumed and a Claymore is granted.

entries.title: The Teacher trades four flowers for a Ph.D Hat
conditions: Requires 1 each of Illusion Flower, Hinalle, Aloe, and Ment; all four are consumed and a Ph.D Hat is granted.

entries.title: Hedrick trades his mother's letter for one cookie
conditions: The branch runs only when tu_acolyte01 is exactly 19 and the player holds at least one Mother's Letter. Otherwise the NPC closes after the opening lines and nothing is exchanged.
On that branch one Mother's Letter is removed, tu_acolyte01 becomes 20, and one Well-baked Cookie is granted. No Zeny or experience is moved.

entries.title: Gyo crafts ninja armguards and armor

outcomes.label: Ninja Scale Armor
outcomes.condition: 30 Fire Dragon Scale + 30 Ice Scale + 30 Darkred Scale Piece

conditions: Four independent recipes selected via a menu variable (.@item_make); each consumes its own materials and grants one item.
A prior checkweight gate stops the branch with no consumption if the player cannot carry the resulting item.

entries.title: Ki crafts ninja weapons
conditions: Three independent recipes selected via a menu variable (.@item_make); each consumes its own materials and grants one item.
A prior checkweight gate stops the branch with no consumption if the player cannot carry the resulting item.

entries.title: Priestess Panno redeems a Temple Lottery Ticket

outcomes.label: Yggdrasil Berry
outcomes.condition: combined ~0.4%+ (bonus_donate==99 fallback) plus a separate 12% band (bonus_donate 77-88)

conditions: Requires 1 Temple Lottery Ticket, consumed unconditionally on redemption.

The reward is a single weighted roll (0-99) with the rarest tier (roll==99) itself sub-rolling a second 0-99 table for one of four rare prizes; percentages are taken directly from the script's own inline comments and verified against the coded thresholds.

entries.title: Middle-Ranked Laphine#la exchanges Sprout for Flower Of Alfheim
conditions: countitem(Germinating_Sprout) > 0
The removal and the grant are the only item calls in this brace branch, and no close, end, menu, loop, or call sits between them.

entries.title: Yoop replaces a lost Warlock magical stone

outcomes.label: Magical Stone (left)
outcomes.condition: Granted only if the player has neither item 2796 equipped nor in inventory.

outcomes.label: Magical Stone (right)
outcomes.condition: Granted only if the player has neither item 2797 equipped nor in inventory.

conditions: Requires 1 3carat Diamond, consumed regardless of which stone(s) are missing.

Each of the two Magical Stone items is granted independently and only if the player is missing that specific one (checked via isequipped and countitem); a player missing both receives both in the same visit.

entries.title: Shining Crystal#tt_b1 exchanges Blue Key for Blue Charm Stone
conditions: countitem(Key_Blue) > 0
The removal and the grant are the only item calls in this brace branch, and no close, end, menu, loop, or call sits between them.

entries.title: Expert Flute Crafter makes a Wolf Flute
conditions: Requires 1 Bamboo Cut and 100,000 zeny; both are consumed and a Wolf Flute is granted.

entries.title: Kotan (and the unnamed villager) trade Meat for crafting materials
conditions: Requires 1 Meat, consumed for 2 Jellopy, 2 Fluff, and 2 Clover together.

The same trade is offered twice in this script under two different display names ("Kotan" and an unnamed "???" villager) at the same map cell, both reachable depending on an unreviewed prior dialogue state; refusing without Meat costs the player HP via percentheal.

entries.title: Audi's snowman machine converts materials into a random festive hat

outcomes.label: Smokie Hat
outcomes.condition: 1 Kitty Band + 20 Dragon Scale + 200 Tough Scalelike Stem + 300 Sea-otter Fur

outcomes.label: Rainbow Eggshell
outcomes.condition: 1 Egg Shell + 1 Cobaltblue Dyestuffs + 50 Claw of Desert Wolf

outcomes.label: Chef Hat
outcomes.condition: 120 Piece of Cake + 1 White Dyestuffs + 330 Feather + 450 Dragon Scale

outcomes.label: Cake Hat
outcomes.condition: 10 Candy + 5 Candy Cane + 15 Well-baked Cookie + 20 Piece of Cake + 10 Steel

conditions: Eight independent recipes selected via a menu; each consumes its own materials and grants one festive hat/item.
Insufficient materials for a given option leaves the branch with no consumption and no grant (the switch falls through with `break`).

entries.title: Gomer crafts a Pile Bunker and returns leftover Steel
conditions: Requires 50 Steel, 30 Flexible Tube, and 1 Brocca; the NPC consumes all three and grants both a Pile Bunker and a Two-handed Axe together in the same branch.
